description: This file implements the SqlNotifyAdminStore class for managing notification admin data in a Mattermost server, including methods for inserting, retrieving, updating, and deleting notification records in a SQL database.

classes.name: SqlNotifyAdminStore
classes.description: A struct that manages notification admin data in the SQL store, providing methods for CRUD operations.

methods.name: newSqlNotifyAdminStore
methods.description: Constructor function to create a new SqlNotifyAdminStore instance.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new NotifyAdminData record into the database.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Validates and saves NotifyAdminData, returning the saved data.

methods.name: GetDataByUserIdAndFeature
methods.description: Retrieves notification data for a specific user and feature.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves notification data based on the trial status and unsent notifications.

methods.name: DeleteBefore
methods.description: Deletes notification records before a certain timestamp for a given trial status.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the SentAt timestamp for a specific user, plan, and feature.
